categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in computer peripherals, imaging optoelectronics, and consumer electronics manufacturing and sales under its own brand 'Genius'. Key product lines include computer peripherals such as mice, keyboards, and gaming accessories; audio products like speakers and headphones; and imaging products including webcams and dashcams. The company also develops gaming peripherals and AI-enhanced computer accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates chip and firmware design, notably developing AI-enhanced peripherals with Copilot AI keys and voice shortcuts. Production involves both in-house manufacturing and outsourcing to optimize inventory and cost. Technologies include Bluetooth dual-mode, USB-C interfaces, wireless charging compliant with EU regulations, and specialized gaming hardware with force feedback. Manufacturing processes include SMT surface mount technology, assembly, quality control, and packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are distributors, retailers, and end consumers in the computer, mobile device, and gaming sectors. The company serves global markets including Asia, Americas, Europe, and Taiwan, with products targeting personal computer users, gamers, and mobile device users. Major customers include regional distributors and channel partners, with a focus on expanding in emerging markets and new countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales in Asia, the Americas, Europe, and Taiwan. It has subsidiaries and manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, Hong Kong, China (Dongguan), the United States, and other regions. Sales are distributed across over 80 countries, with strategic focus on expanding presence in the Americas, Asia-Pacific, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs and assembles computer peripherals and electronic products, sourcing key components such as ICs, sensors, PCBs, and optical parts from upstream suppliers. It manages manufacturing both internally and through contract manufacturers, and sells finished products through distributors and retailers to end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing AI-integrated peripherals (Copilot AI series), expanding USB-C and Bluetooth-enabled products, and enhancing gaming accessories. R&D focuses on integrating AI assistant functions, multi-interface compatibility, and energy-efficient designs aligned with ESG goals. The company plans to leverage the Windows 10 end-of-support upgrade cycle and growing AI PC market to drive product innovation and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of computer peripherals, audio devices, imaging products, and gaming accessories. The company sells products under its own brand and through OEM/ODM arrangements. Additional income comes from interest income, foreign exchange gains, and asset disposals, but the core model is product manufacturing and sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Logitech and Microsoft in computer peripherals, Edifier and various Chinese brands in audio products, and Logitech, Razer, and SteelSeries in gaming peripherals. The company positions itself as a value-for-money brand with a strong legacy, emphasizing competitive pricing, product innovation, and reliable quality to maintain market share against both global brands and low-cost Chinese manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$978.8 million in 2024, a 27% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to the parent company nearly doubling to NT$142.6 million. It maintains a strong financial structure with low debt ratio (~13.6%), high liquidity, and positive cash flows. R&D expenses are about 0.8%-1% of revenue, supporting steady growth and product development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high cost-performance ratio products with innovative features such as AI Copilot integration, USB-C and Bluetooth connectivity, and ergonomic designs. It leverages nearly 40 years of brand heritage and the invention of the mouse scroll wheel to build consumer trust. The focus on continuous innovation, quality assurance, and responsive customer service differentiates it from low-cost competitors and supports loyal customer base retention.
